overview.title: Overview
overview.emptyDescription: Once seed data is loaded, your club status, next match and recommendations appear here. An admin can run “make seed”.

prep.title: Match prep
prep.emptyDescription: Once fixtures are loaded, pick the next match to prepare recommendations and the weekly plan.

opponents.title: Opponent analysis
opponents.emptyDescription: Once league data is loaded, pick an opponent to review its set-piece profile, findings and sequences.

league.title: League
league.emptyDescription: Standings and set-piece tables appear here once league data is loaded.

routines.title: Routines
routines.emptyDescription: You will be able to create your first routine from templates. The routine editor arrives in phase 3.

live.title: Live tagging
live.emptyDescription: On match day, pick a fixture to tag set pieces on a tablet. Works offline.

video.title: Video hub
video.emptyDescription: You will be able to upload match video and link set-piece clips to tags.

reports.title: Reports
